_comment: DATA rule table for media.classify (plan §9/§15 T06). Each rule: when (input-shape predicate — every key present must match the observed shape) -> definition (workflow-definition id). First matching rule wins; rules are ordered most-specific first. Adding a style's selection logic = adding one row here, zero code.

ai_mode._comment: When no rule matches (or mode:'ai' is forced), the local CLI picks among the published definitions or emits a new one. Local CLI only — no provider API key (constraint F2).
ai_mode.prompt_template: You are a content-style selector. Given this input shape JSON: {shape} and these available workflow definition ids: {definitions} — reply with ONLY the single best definition id for producing content from these inputs, nothing else.
